Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 14:10:00 -0700
Subject: Security/compliance discovery — SOC 2 + roadmap (post-call recap)

Hi Chris —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps so your security and procurement teams have what they need: 

Summary of what we heard from you:
- You require SOC 2 Type II coverage for vendors that will handle customer data; procurement timeline targets a vendor decision by end of Q2.
- GDPR data residency and DPA are a gating item for EMEA workloads.
- You have potential PHI use cases; need clarity on HIPAA / BAA support for any PHI workflows.

What Redwood will provide next (deliverables + timeline):
1) Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (attached) — short summary of our current SOC posture and evidence we can provide.
2) Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Template.xlsx (attached) — our standard questionnaire template to kick off procurement/security review; we can pre-fill common answers.
3) Compliance roadmap overview — ISO 27001 and FedRAMP are on our roadmap; I included Lauren and Rishi to coordinate specific timelines and scope expansion requests.
4) Technical 1:1 — propose a 45-minute session next week to walk your security engineers through network isolation, key management (KMS/HSM), and data residency options.

As next steps from your side:
- Please confirm the preferred owner for the vendor security questionnaire and any required format (Excel / DocuSign).
- Share any additional evidence examples your team will need (e.g., encryption in transit/at rest certificates, pen test reports).
- Confirm 2–3 time slots for a technical 1:1 next week.

I attached the SOC summary and questionnaire template to get the process started. If it helps, we can also pre-populate the questionnaire and return it within 48 hours.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf; Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Template.xlsx

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments — very helpful. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement timeline: we need vendor security review completed by 30 Jun 2026 to meet our rollout schedule.
- SOC 2: We need to confirm whether Redwood will have SOC 2 Type II before our procurement decision or at least provide interim attestations. Can you give an ETA for Type II?
- HIPAA/PHI: For any PHI workloads we need a BAA and support for customer-managed keys (KMS). Does Redwood support customer-controlled encryption keys on Dedicated or Private deployments?

I've attached our procurement timeline PDF and I'll loop in our security manager if we proceed to the questionnaire.

Appreciate the rapid follow-up — we can do a tech 1:1 next Wed or Thu afternoon PT.

Thanks,
Chris Turner
Director of IT Security, EnterpriseCorp
chris.turner@enterprisecorp.com

Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security/compliance discovery — SOC 2 + roadmap (post-call recap)

Hi Chris — thanks — quick answers below and proposed next steps.

SOC 2 status:
- Redwood completed SOC 2 Type I in Q1 2025. We are currently in process for SOC 2 Type II with an expected report window of Q3 2026. While the final Type II report is targeted for Q3, we can provide:
  - The Type I report and our control matrix (attached).
  - Interim evidence (policy docs, control evidence extracts, and recent external penetration test report) to support procurement review.

HIPAA / PHI support:
- We support PHI under a BAA for Dedicated and Private deployment options. Customer-managed key integrations (KMS/HSM) are available on Dedicated and Private for customers requiring customer-controlled encryption keys. For Hosted API customers we offer strong encryption in transit/at rest and a DPA, but customer-managed keys are supported only on Private/Dedicated.

GDPR / data residency:
- We offer region-aware deployments and can provide a DPA + Data Processing Addendum. Lauren will share standard language and regional hosting options.

FedRAMP / ISO roadmap:
- ISO 27001: planned evaluation in H2 2026, target certification in 2027.
- FedRAMP: exploratory scoping work underway; multi-year program dependent on customer demand and resource prioritization.

Next steps (what I can do immediately):
- Pre-fill the Vendor Security Questionnaire and return within 48 hours — will include references to the attachments above.
- Schedule the technical 1:1 — proposed slots: Wed 03/10 10:00–10:45 PT or Thu 03/11 13:00–13:45 PT. Please confirm which works for your team.
- Lauren and Rishi (cc'd) will follow up with more detailed roadmap items and any additional evidence we can share.

If helpful I can also provide a short one-page compliance snapshot tailored to EnterpriseCorp summarizing SOC timeline, PHI support, and hosting options.

Best,
Marissa
